items.passage: Transcript: Hi, this is Mira Lindqvist, volunteer coordinator at the campus radio station. Training for volunteers has always been on Thursdays at 12:30 p.m., during the lunch hour. This term it moves to Monday at 4:00 p.m., still in Room 421. The microphones in Room 421 are brand new. Listeners won't hear a difference, but they run through a different mixing board, so even returning DJs who trained last year need to come to one session before going back on air. There is one exception to the new schedule. Because the sports desk broadcasts the Monday afternoon matches, sports reporters keep the old Thursday slot at 12:30. That arrangement is only for the sports desk. If you can't make your session, call me at extension 8362 and I'll find you a make-up time.
